notes: The two-level chain remnant of the sea coast: the of belongs to חוֹף as rectum of שְׁאֵרִית, while הַיָּם is rendered attributively before it (rules 19, 28), so חוֹף's unit is discontinuous.
The written article on הַיָּם takes the the standing before its own word; שְׁאֵרִית takes a supplied one (rule 29).
הַאֲבַדְתִּי takes only destroy: the subject and auxiliary are not rewritten for the second coordinated verb (rule 22).
The anarthrous gentilics פְּלִשְׁתִּים and כְּרֵתִים take their supplied the into their own units (rule 46).
